policy: Only correctness, soundness, interoperability, and reproducible fixture authorities may live under tools/. Retained profiling and paired-statistics helpers live under tools/perf/; one-off research helpers are not retained. Every retained root has a bounded PR lane and an extraction condition.

perf.required_for: Frozen paired-ratio statistics for the Native CUDA benchmark runner and the stwo-prof Zig/Metal/CUDA isolation and profiling CLI
perf.extraction: publish as a standalone Python package once no repository script imports stwo_perf.stats

cairo-witness-compiler.extraction: externalize after an authenticated generator release reproduces the committed topology

stwo-air-derive-vector-gen.required_for: Independent upstream AIR derive parity vectors
stwo-air-derive-vector-gen.extraction: replace with committed Zig cases or an immutable native-oracle bundle

stwo-cairo-air-compiler.extraction: externalize after authenticated artifacts reproduce every committed AIR template

stwo-cairo-official-verifier-rs.required_for: Official Cairo proof acceptance independent of Zig
stwo-cairo-official-verifier-rs.extraction: consume a permanent content-addressed oracle binary from a companion authority repository

stwo-cairo-trace-oracle.extraction: externalize once checkpoint regeneration is authenticated and clean-room reproducible

stwo-cairo-verifier-rs.required_for: Legacy SN2 envelope compatibility still used by the Cairo Rust oracle bridge
stwo-cairo-verifier-rs.extraction: retire after every consumer uses the official verifier format

stwo-cairo-vm-adapter-rs.required_for: Execute Cairo source programs before Zig proving
stwo-cairo-vm-adapter-rs.extraction: publish as an optional versioned sidecar while retaining pure-Zig ProverInput proving

stwo-cf-vector-gen.extraction: consolidate into the external native-oracle workspace

stwo-circuit-oracle-rs.required_for: Authenticated circuit recursion parity checkpoints and the compiled-AIR projection
stwo-circuit-oracle-rs.extraction: externalize once checkpoint regeneration is authenticated and clean-room reproducible

stwo-cuda-adapter-rs.required_for: Independent CUDA bring-up and qualification evidence
stwo-cuda-adapter-rs.extraction: externalize after current-device Zig CUDA parity and activation evidence is reproducible

stwo-eval-program-abi.required_for: The evaluation-program recorder and STWZEVA bundle encoder shared by the official Cairo AIR compiler and the circuit recursion oracle
stwo-eval-program-abi.extraction: externalize together with its last consumer, tools/stwo-cairo-air-compiler or tools/stwo-circuit-oracle-rs

stwo-interop-rs.required_for: Cross-language Native proof compatibility and independent verification
stwo-interop-rs.extraction: consume a permanent content-addressed oracle binary from a companion authority repository

stwo-trace-digest.required_for: The domain-separated trace column and accumulator digests shared by the Cairo trace oracle and the circuit recursion oracle
stwo-trace-digest.extraction: externalize together with its last consumer, tools/stwo-cairo-trace-oracle or tools/stwo-circuit-oracle-rs

stwo-vector-gen.extraction: consolidate into the external native-oracle workspace

rv64-cuda-callsites.required_for: Retained driver-callsite attribution for the ordered RV64 resource census; inventory declaration does not qualify hardware measurements
rv64-cuda-callsites.extraction: Consolidate under the existing tools/perf owner with the retained counter shim; preserve source and external measurement build references during that move

rv64-cuda-counters.required_for: Retained driver-call counts consumed by the RV64 measurement owner
rv64-cuda-counters.extraction: Consolidate under tools/perf after the measurement owner verifies its source/build references; no hardware qualification follows from this inventory

starknet-aggregator-rs.required_for: Build the pinned Starknet aggregator CairoPie from ordered public preimages for the existing fixture pipeline
starknet-aggregator-rs.extraction: Publish as a pinned optional execution sidecar when the Starknet product owns authenticated aggregator fixtures

starknet-block-collector.required_for: Collect and assemble replayable Starknet OS inputs and drive the existing leaf/aggregator fixture pipeline
starknet-block-collector.extraction: Externalize network collection behind immutable fixtures once the Starknet product has an authenticated offline regeneration owner
